source_class: user-provided rear dimensioned image, physical Z measurements, reconciled front-glass/visible-window measurements, and orientation-controlled full-cable FFC photograph for the final DSI506/DYL0023 display module

physical_z_measurements.status: physical scalar Z envelope measured; local XY obstruction map and FFC bend envelope remain open

source_dimension_notes: Rear PCB and eight-hole nominal XY raster come from the user-provided dimensioned rear image; the 0.001 mm edge-label discrepancy is treated as image rounding and nominalized to 5.000 mm where explicitly dimensioned.
Z evidence is physical user measurement: A=7.00 mm, B=5.00 mm, C=10.00 mm.
Front glass is physically measured at 120.00 x 75.00 mm and visible width at 110.00 mm; L=5.00 mm and R=5.00 mm reconcile exactly.

Final vertical datum is resolved from one common top-glass reference: Y1=2.00 mm to visible top and Y2=69.00 mm to visible bottom, giving visible height 67.00 mm and bottom offset 6.00 mm. This supersedes the earlier inconsistent T=3/B=7 readings.
The full DSI FFC photographed flat and untwisted proves opposite-side exposed contacts: Type-B/reverse-contact cable.
No FFC bend radius, module receptacle pin-1 orientation, connector-center XY, or local XY position of the 10 mm maximum rear protrusion is inferred.
